title: Upper Shoulder Line Gliding
summary: Smooth passes follow the soft tissues along the upper shoulder line from the base of the neck outward.
goal: Move progressively along the upper shoulder line while supporting relaxation of the upper trapezius.
imageAlt: Educational diagram of a smooth glide along the upper shoulder line.
startingPosition: The shoulders are relaxed, with the practitioner's hands resting over the soft tissue between the base of the neck and outer shoulder.
instructions: Begin on the soft tissue near the base of the neck.
Glide the palm or finger pads outward along the upper shoulder line.
Pass around bony prominences without extra pressure.
Reduce pressure near the shoulder joint.
direction: From the base of the neck outward along the upper shoulder line.
tips: Follow soft tissue rather than bony landmarks.
Keep the movement long and continuous.
mistakes: Applying strong pressure near the base of the neck.
warning: Do not perform this technique over acute localized pain or a recent shoulder injury.
telegramCaption: A smooth glide from the base of the neck outward along the upper shoulder line.
